The '''''Galactic Horizon''''' was an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Manollium-class herdship|''Manollium''-class herdship]].

==History==
It was one of the many [[Ithorian Herdship]]s which could travel between [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]. Under the guidance of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Roogak (Ithorian)|Roogak]], the herdship was active during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="GC6" />
